items.exampleEn: The driver could not account for the two missing boxes.
items.exampleZh: 司機無法說明那兩個箱子為什麼不見了。

items.exampleEn: An argument broke out between two customers at the counter.
items.exampleZh: 櫃台前的兩位客人之間爆發了一場爭吵。

items.exampleEn: After years of failed tests, the research team finally broke through.
items.exampleZh: 經過多年失敗的試驗，研究團隊終於有了突破。

items.exampleEn: What brought this sudden decision about?
items.exampleZh: 是什麼促成了這個突然的決定？

items.exampleEn: The singer is bringing her third album out next month.
items.exampleZh: 這位歌手下個月要推出她的第三張專輯。

items.exampleEn: The report calls for stricter rules on plastic bags.
items.exampleZh: 這份報告要求對塑膠袋訂定更嚴格的規定。

items.exampleEn: Paying by phone has caught on in many countries.
items.exampleZh: 用手機付款已經在許多國家流行起來。

items.sentenceEn: This job calls for a lot of patience.
items.sentenceZh: 這份工作需要很大的耐心。

items.audioEn: Since the new manager arrived, she has brought about many changes, and the office runs much more smoothly now.
items.audioZh: 新經理來了之後帶來了許多改變，現在辦公室運作得順暢多了。
items.questionZh: 新經理來了以後，辦公室怎麼了？
options: More people want to leave the company
The manager plans to move to another office

items.sentenceEn: Short videos have really caught on with teenagers.
items.sentenceZh: 短影片在青少年之間真的流行起來了。

items.sentenceEn: Rent accounts for half of my monthly spending.
items.sentenceZh: 房租占了我每個月開銷的一半。

items.stemEn: The phone maker plans to ____ a cheaper model later this year.
items.stemZh: 這家手機製造商打算在今年稍晚推出一款比較便宜的機型。

items.stemEn: When our team scored in the last minute, loud cheers ____ in the stadium.
items.stemZh: 我們隊在最後一分鐘得分時，體育場裡爆出響亮的歡呼聲。

items.passageEn: Last year, Mia's small bakery was losing customers, so she decided to bring out a new kind of bread made with sweet potato. At first, sales were slow, and her staff were worried. However, after a popular food writer wrote about it online, the bread quickly caught on. Within two months, it became the bakery's best-selling item. Mia says the success called for hard work from everyone, not just a good idea. She is now planning to open a second shop near the train station.
items.passageZh: 去年，Mia 的小麵包店客人越來越少，所以她決定推出一款用地瓜做的新麵包。一開始銷量很慢，店員都很擔心。不過，一位很受歡迎的美食作家在網路上介紹這款麵包之後，它很快就流行起來。不到兩個月，它就成了店裡最暢銷的商品。Mia 說，這次成功需要每個人努力，而不只是一個好點子。她現在正計畫在火車站附近開第二家店。

questions.questionZh: Mia 為什麼推出新的麵包？
options: 有位美食作家建議她這麼做
地瓜的價格突然變得很便宜

questions.questionZh: Mia 認為這次成功需要什麼？
options: 美食作家寫的那篇很受歡迎的文章
所有人一起努力，不只是好點子

items.promptZh: 在昨天的比賽中，我們隊在最後五分鐘突破了對方的防守。
referenceEn: In yesterday's game, our team broke through the other team's defense in the last five minutes.
Our team broke through their defense in the last five minutes of yesterday's game.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「突破」（例如 broke through their defense 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 got through their defense、broke past their defense 等）
有「昨天」，用過去式（例如 broke through 等）
「對方」可寫，例如 the other team、their、the other side 等

items.promptZh: 很多市民要求增加公車班次。
referenceEn: Many citizens are calling for more buses.
Many people in the city call for more frequent buses.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「要求」（例如 are calling for、call for 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 asked for more buses、demanded more buses 等）
時態可用現在式、現在進行式、現在完成式或過去式（例如 call for、are calling for、have called for 等）
「增加公車班次」可寫，例如 more buses、more frequent buses、more bus services 等
